decision.observation: 8:20 pm; the bobber landed on the stump to the north-east of the farmer, not in the pond (line runs up-left from the rod).
decision.hypothesis: The cast direction may be north, not south; stepping down to the bank so water lies directly below should make any southward cast land in the pond.
decision.memory: Facing south then C previously put the bobber into the pond at 6:50 pm; now it hit the stump.
